rca_of_the_issue: Navigation to Market Robot page failed because: 1) The sidebar has nested collapsible sections, 2) Clicking on section headers sometimes doesn't expand them properly in Playwright, 3) The Market Robot is a tab inside RevenuePanel, not a direct sidebar link. The backend APIs are working correctly - all scan endpoints accept days_ahead parameter and return expected responses.
